summary: Isolated teal square emits lines in four directions, turning on obstacle contact based on legend color bar position.
path: extend in 4 cardinal directions; on hitting obstacle, turn counterclockwise if legend shows same-color bar on left, clockwise if on right
trajectory: paint teal along path until obstacle or grid edge
symbol_instructions: legend entries: obstacle_color with bar on left → counterclockwise turn; bar on right → clockwise turn
